_: AUTHORITY: this file is TRANSCRIBED FROM THE GATE'S OWN FIRST RUN, never from prose. It was seeded EMPTY and the run printed every cell below. ADR-0344's ledger shipped a hand-typed '52 cells / 27 SILENT' header and its first run read 64/39 — which is why nothing here is typed by hand.
_reading: First reading 2026-08-21 (lane RAC3, L-2211): 112 panel-visible (family x property) cells across 15 families — 36 BOTH, 1 EXECUTE-ONLY, 0 QUERY-ONLY, 75 SILENT. Arms A/B/C hard-0 and clean (17 query rows mirror their write twin; no QUERY-ONLY cell; 0 declared refusals).
_rule: BOTH SILENT LISTS ARE SHRINK-ONLY AND NAMED, never a bare integer: the subject is 112 concurrently-edited cells and a count alone could not tell 'door.handleHeight was wired' from 'wall.height regressed'. A cell that is PAID must leave this file in the commit that pays it — the gate exits 3 on stale debt for exactly the reason ADR-0344 gives: debt left behind hides the next regression inside it.
_executeOnlyNote: wall.materialColor is settable (set-wall-color -> wall.updateColorBatch) and not askable, and that is HONEST rather than an oversight: PropertyReader's contract is NUMERIC (PropertyReadOutcome carries a number), and a colour is a hex string. Reporting it needs a second reader shape, which is a decision and not a patch — recorded here rather than fixed quietly. It is the ONLY such cell: rakeAngleDeg was the other, and this feature's own gate is what named it (see the rake-angle row in PropertyQuery.ts).
_refusalsNote: EMPTY, and deliberately. A property-granular refusal table is only worth anything once a GRAMMAR CLAIMS the sentence — a table nothing reaches is authored-but-unwired, which is worse than an honest gap because it reads as coverage. Named as step 2 of ADR-0345's plan with its cost, not half-built here.
unmeasuredPanels: apps/editor/src/ui/property-inspector/RoomPropertySection.ts — the ROOM panel is hand-built cards, not table rows.
